name: Adlink Technology Inc.
summary: Adlink Technology Inc. manufactures and sells hardware, software, and peripheral equipment of industrial computers in the Asia Pacific, Mainland China, the United States, and Europe. The company offers computer-on-modules such as COM Express and HPC, OSM, SMARC, Qseven, and ETX; GPU solutions, including MXM GPU modules, and PCIe graphics cards; and rugged computing solutions, comprising compactPCI and compactPCI serial, PC104, VPX, AVA railway rugged computers, and passenger information display system.
